Name: Kezia
Summary: Kezia was Job's second daughter after his restoration, named in Job 42 among the three daughters born when God restored Job's fortunes.
KeyStory: With her sisters Jemima and Keren-happuch, Kezia received an inheritance from her father alongside her brothers — an unusual honour in that time.
LifeLesson: Kezia's inheritance shows that restoration in God's hands can include dignity and honour beyond mere replacement.
